pages.text: Use a Subterranodon as the mid-game transport step between ground mounts and an Elytra.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Tame a Subterranodon with Trilocaris Tails. Control it in flight for at least two seconds and select a safe landing place before you travel.
